cards.example_es: El precio de la vivienda no para de subir.
cards.example_en: Housing prices keep going up.

cards.example_es: Defendemos una sanidad pública de calidad.
cards.example_en: We defend quality public healthcare.

cards.example_es: El ayuntamiento promete crear empleo.
cards.example_en: The council promises to create jobs.

cards.example_es: Hay que proteger el medioambiente.
cards.example_en: We must protect the environment.

cards.example_es: La justicia es muy lenta en este país.
cards.example_en: The justice system is very slow in this country.

cards.example_es: Las enfermeras reivindican más personal.
cards.example_en: The nurses are demanding more staff.

cards.example_es: Defendemos los derechos de los inquilinos.
cards.example_en: We defend tenants' rights.

cards.example_es: Todo el mundo tiene derecho a una vivienda digna.
cards.example_en: Everyone has the right to decent housing.

cards.example_es: La asociación lucha contra la corrupción.
cards.example_en: The association fights against corruption.

cards.example_es: Luchan por la sanidad pública.
cards.example_en: They fight for public healthcare.

cards.example_es: Los vecinos protestan por el ruido de los bares.
cards.example_en: The residents are protesting about the noise from the bars.

cards.example_es: Exigimos el cierre de la incineradora.
cards.example_en: We demand the closure of the incinerator.

cards.example_es: El sábado hay una manifestación en el centro.
cards.example_en: There's a demonstration in the centre on Saturday.

cards.example_es: Hemos organizado una recogida de firmas.
cards.example_en: We've organised a petition.

cards.example_es: Pedimos un salario digno.
cards.example_en: We're asking for a decent wage.

cards.example_es: Protestan contra la subida de los alquileres.
cards.example_en: They're protesting against the rise in rents.

cards.example_es: Ha habido una bajada de precios.
cards.example_en: There's been a fall in prices.

cards.example_es: El cierre de la biblioteca fue una mala noticia.
cards.example_en: The library closure was bad news.

cards.example_es: Celebramos la apertura del nuevo centro de salud.
cards.example_en: We celebrated the opening of the new health centre.

cards.example_es: Pedimos una reducción de los impuestos.
cards.example_en: We're asking for a tax reduction.

cards.example_es: El abandono de animales aumenta en verano.
cards.example_en: Pet abandonment rises in summer.

cards.example_es: Luchamos contra la discriminación laboral.
cards.example_en: We fight against discrimination at work.

cards.example_es: El paro ha disminuido un dos por ciento.
cards.example_en: Unemployment has decreased by two per cent.

cards.example_es: Los alumnos tendrán que trasladarse en autobús.
cards.example_en: Students will have to travel by bus.

cards.example_es: El ayuntamiento realizará obras en la plaza.
cards.example_en: The council will carry out works in the square.

cards.example_es: Cursa el último año de Medicina.
cards.example_en: She's in her final year of Medicine.

cards.example_es: Hay que pedir cita en el ayuntamiento.
cards.example_en: You have to make an appointment at the town hall.

cards.example_es: Escribimos una carta abierta a la alcaldesa.
cards.example_en: We wrote an open letter to the mayor.

cards.example_es: Han aprobado una nueva ley de vivienda.
cards.example_en: They've passed a new housing law.

cards.example_es: Ojalá bajen los alquileres.
cards.example_en: I hope rents come down.
